verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is event backfills, which let you replay historical usage in bulk. Other operations, such as Subscription Edits, are explicitly scoped to a single subscription, and no batch or bulk update, issuance or mutation endpoints are documented. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints for updating many subscriptions, customers or invoices at once, bulk actions in UI or MCP, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Orb is fundamentally architected to support event backfills, which makes it easy to replay historical usage
